assertions.description: The WebGPU entry point navigator.gpu exists on Navigator.
Queries the default WebGPU GPUAdapter and checks whether adapter.features.has('atomic-vec2u-min-max') is exposed on the hardware adapter.

When a GPUDevice is created with requiredFeatures: ['atomic-vec2u-min-max'], a compute shader with 'enable atomic_vec2u_min_max;' and 'atomicMin(&buf[0], vec2u(1u, 2u))' compiles with zero WGSL compilation errors.
assertions.test: (async()=>{try{if(!navigator.gpu)return false;const adapter=await navigator.gpu.requestAdapter();if(!adapter||!adapter.features.has('atomic-vec2u-min-max'))return false;const device=await adapter.requestDevice({requiredFeatures:['atomic-vec2u-min-max']});const module=device.createShaderModule({code:'enable atomic_vec2u_min_max; @group(0) @binding(0) var<storage, read_write> buf: array<atomic<vec2u>>; @compute @workgroup_size(1) fn main() { let old = atomicMin(&buf[0], vec2u(1u, 2u)); }'});const info=await module.getCompilationInfo();return !info.messages.some(m=>m.type==='error');}catch(e){return false;}})()
